title: Notification regarding sitting in Division Bench for Hon'ble Judges (including Hon'ble The Chief Justice) will sit single at 11:30 AM or after .
text:
KEY LINES:
Division Bench from 22.06.2026 to 26.06.2026 will sit single at 11:30 am or after rising of

FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
AT IMPHAL
NOTIFICATION
Imphal, the 20th June, 2026
No. HCM/1/96-BENCH/ : it is hereby informed to all learned members of
the Bar and litigants that Hon'ble Judges (including Hon’ble the Chief Justice) sitting in
Division Bench from 22.06.2026 to 26.06.2026 will sit single at 11:30 am or after rising of
Division Bench, whichever is earlier.
By Order etc.
Sd/-
(KH. A]IT SINGH)
REGISTRAR (JUDL.)
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
Endt. No. HCM/1/96-BENCH/\“4+Cq -XI Imphal, the 20th June, 2026
